Review complete. **Verdict: approve** (tier2 — holds for human sign-off, not auto-mergeable).

Summary: the diff correctly identifies and closes the last-owner/admin lockout gap on `PATCH /api/org-members/[id]` — the only endpoint in the codebase that can mutate `memberships.role` (verified via grep sweep of all mutation/DELETE handlers), with sound transition logic and good test coverage. Independently verified `tsc --noEmit` (clean) and `eslint` (zero warnings) rather than trusting the self-report; `bun test` couldn't be re-run since bun isn't installed in this sandbox. The migration is a clean additive check-constraint change. No `.github/workflows/**` involvement.

Two notes flagged for the human reviewer:
1. A minor TOCTOU race — concurrent demotions of two different owner/admins at the last-two-remaining point could theoretically both pass the count check.
2. This branch sits on top of unmerged PR #53 (locally merged, not rebased) — merge ordering needs human reconciliation before landing on `main`.
